ownerDirective.interpretation: The Governor delegates the finite SYS03 Cobalt station-pair release roles to the implementation team and removes outside-signature waiting. This standing authority is limited to the exact release node and never waives the scoped hard-safety kernel.

mvpBoundary.included: Only the exact SYS03 Cobalt Westlight–Ravensreach passive-rail transaction passed to the scoped runner.
mvpBoundary.exclusionRule: This authorization does not authorize the R10 normal-alignment or north-turn holds, powered rail, vehicles, signals, a public route, or passenger service.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Independent structural QA must bind complete canonical block states, exact target bijection, package disjointness, and forward/rollback inversion.
Every live invocation captures a fresh immutable complete source snapshot and passes exact forward source preflight in package order.
Every forward and rollback operation file must pass strict-noop parser validation before mutation.
The exact target set must be clear of block entities and fresh same-moment live entities before execution.
Forward execution must be strict-noop and journaled. Any failure triggers the exact inverse for the partial and already-committed package set in reverse order.
A fresh immutable post snapshot, exact rollback poststate preflight, and release-specific functional isolation QA are mandatory before an as-built claim.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: A failed safety check blocks only this exact release and cannot broaden into the disjoint R10 holds.
